data.long_meaning: Sarab means 'great' and jeet means 'victory'. Sarabjeet means 'God is great, God is the victor'. The name Sarabjeet carries the meaning “God is great” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Punjabi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sarabjeet usually hope their child will grow to embody god is great and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sarabjeet total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Sarabjeet Singh was a highly decorated military officer in the Indian Army, who was posthumously awarded the Param Vir Chakra, India's highest military decoration, for his actions during the 1971 Indo-Pakistan War.

Sarabjeet Singh was an influential figure in the Sikh community in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. He was a prominent leader during the Ghadar Movement, a rebellion against British rule in India, and was also a key figure in the establishment of the Ghadar Party.
